'''Wight rangers''' are undead enemies summoned by [[Sliske]] encountered during [[Missing, Presumed Death]].

Wight rangers also have a chance to be summoned and fight for the player by wearing the upgraded Mask of Sliske ([[Mask of Sliske, Light (Dishonour among Thieves)|Light]] or [[Mask of Sliske, Shadow (Dishonour among Thieves)|Shadow]]) from [[Dishonour among Thieves]] in either the head or pocket slot. The rangers summoned have no combat level and inflict low [[ranged]] damage. The rangers cannot be used in conjunction with [[dreadnip]]s nor do they summon in [[PvP]].

After doing some damage, the following message appears in the chat box: {{RSFont|Your wight has served its purpose and left.}} If the wight is unable to attack, the following message appears in the chat box, {{RSFont|The wight couldn't attack so it left.}} If you happen to leave the wight's proximity it will disappear, giving the message: {{RSFont|The wight left as it lost sight of you.}}
